title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计长上下文推理模型的 RL、沙盒任务与开放权重边界的读者
one_line: MiniMax-M1 releases 40K and 80K model weights and reports separate continual-pretraining, Long-CoT SFT, and mixed-feedback RL recipes, but not the training rows, reward traces, sandboxes, or training code needed for replay.
MiniMax-M1 披露混合注意力推理模型、面向含沙盒软件工程问题的大规模 RL 与 CISPO，但未公开训练数据、奖励或 rollout 审计工件。
why: It is a useful frontier-report ledger for comparing what is disclosed about source mixtures, filtering, verifiers, execution environments, curricula, weights, and evaluation against what remains unavailable.
inclusion_reason: MiniMax-M1 is a high-value frontier disclosure because it separates continual pretraining, Long-CoT SFT, rule- and execution-verified RL, model-scored general RL, and a long-output curriculum while releasing the 40K and 80K weights; it also leaves clear data, verifier, rights, and replay gaps for audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MiniMax-M1 asks how a large reasoning model can extend output-time computation to tens of thousands of tokens while training on a mixture of easy-to-check reasoning tasks, executable software work, and open-ended general prompts. The report combines an efficient hybrid-attention architecture with continual pretraining, a Long-CoT supervised warm start, CISPO reinforcement learning, and a curriculum that grows the output limit from 40K to 80K.

For a frontier disclosure ledger, four claims must remain separate. MiniMax releases model weights; MiniMax publishes model-definition and deployment code; the report describes aggregate data and reward recipes; and benchmark tables measure resulting model behavior. Only the first three are evidence about openness, and none by itself establishes that the underlying training records, reward traces, or environments can be inspected and replayed.

The central audit problem is therefore lineage across stages. The report gives concrete domain counts and feedback contracts for much of RL, but much less for the 7.5T-token continual-pretraining corpus and Long-CoT SFT mixture. It does not release item-level prompt origins, SFT responses, policy rollout groups, reward outputs, software sandboxes, or a run manifest connecting records to MiniMax-M1-40k and MiniMax-M1-80k.

MiniMax-M1 关注如何让大型推理模型把输出阶段计算扩展到数万 token，同时在易验证推理任务、可执行软件工程任务与开放式通用提示的混合上稳定训练。报告把高效混合注意力架构、继续预训练、Long-CoT 监督热启动、CISPO 强化学习，以及从 40K 扩展到 80K 输出上限的课程结合起来。

在前沿披露账本中，需要分开四类主张：MiniMax 是否发布模型权重，是否公开模型定义与部署代码，报告是否描述聚合级数据和奖励配方，以及基准表如何衡量训练后模型。前三类才与开放程度相关，但任何一类都不能单独证明底层训练记录、奖励轨迹或环境可供检查和重放。

因此，核心审计问题是跨阶段血缘。报告对大部分 RL 给出了较具体的领域数量与反馈契约，对 7.5T token 继续预训练语料和 Long-CoT SFT 混合则披露较少。逐条提示来源、SFT 回答、策略 rollout 组、奖励输出、软件沙盒以及把记录连接到 MiniMax-M1-40k 和 MiniMax-M1-80k 的运行清单均未发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The training path is deliberately staged. MiniMax-Text-01 first receives 7.5T additional non-synthetic tokens, with STEM, code, books, and reasoning raised to 70 percent and context extended from 32K to 1M. Long-CoT SFT then teaches reflective reasoning across math, code, STEM, writing, QA, and multi-turn chat; math and code are about 60 percent of that mixture, but its total size, sources, and response authors are unknown.

RL starts with tasks whose final outcomes can be checked by rules or execution. Math uses answer extraction and checking, SynLogic supplies task generators and verifiers for 41 logic families, competitive programming uses tests, and software engineering runs proposed changes in containers against relevant tests. The policy later receives 25K general prompts scored by Generative Reward Models or by combined rule and model feedback.

CISPO is the optimizer scaffold joining these feedback regimes. It clips importance-sampling weights rather than token updates, uses group-relative advantage, dynamic sampling, length shaping, and no KL term. The curriculum begins with rule-verifiable reasoning and gradually adds model-scored general tasks. For the 80K phase, the 40K model filters easy prompts, harder math and code gain weight, and repetitive synthetic reasoning is downsampled.

This composition is more informative than a weights-only release, but it remains report-level. The official artifacts contain the 40K/80K weights, model code, and deployment guides; they do not contain the training rows, reward model, rollout history, execution bundle, or exact training implementation.

训练路径被明确分成多个阶段。MiniMax-Text-01 先继续训练 7.5T 非合成 token，其中 STEM、代码、书籍和推理相关内容提高到 70%，上下文从 32K 逐步扩到 1M。随后，Long-CoT SFT 在数学、代码、STEM、写作、问答和多轮对话上注入反思式推理；数学与代码约占该混合的 60%，但总规模、具体来源和回答作者均为 unknown。

RL 先使用能够通过规则或执行检查最终结果的任务。数学采用答案抽取与校验，SynLogic 为 41 类逻辑任务提供生成器与验证器，竞赛编程依赖测试，软件工程则在容器中执行模型提出的修改并运行相关测试。之后再加入 25K 条通用提示，由 Generative Reward Model 或规则与模型的组合反馈评分。

CISPO 是把这些反馈机制连接起来的优化框架。它裁剪重要性采样权重而非 token 更新，采用组相对优势、动态采样、长度塑形且不使用 KL 项。课程从规则可验证推理开始，逐步混入模型评分的通用任务。进入 80K 阶段后，40K 模型用于过滤简单提示，更困难的数学与代码提高权重，容易重复的合成推理数据则被降采样。

这种组合比只发布权重提供了更多信息，但仍停留在报告层。官方制品包含 40K/80K 权重、模型代码与部署指南，却不包含训练记录、奖励模型、rollout 历史、执行环境包或精确训练实现。

title: Method
方法
html:
Continual pretraining and SFT must be read separately from RL. The 7.5T-token stage refines Web and PDF parsing, extracts natural QA pairs from webpages, forums, and textbooks, applies semantic deduplication, and explicitly avoids synthetic data. Long-CoT SFT covers six broad domains and is described only as curated high-quality examples. No SFT count, source manifest, teacher list, candidate budget, filter ledger, or model-stage assignment is disclosed.

The verifiable RL pool has four components. Math begins with hundreds of thousands of public and official-competition problems, removes malformed and unsuitable forms, deduplicates RL sources, separates them from SFT, filters similarity to common math tests, extracts reference answers, and keeps questions with a strong model's pass@10 strictly between 0 and 0.9, leaving nearly 50K. SynLogic generates about 53K instances across 41 task types with model-solvability bounds and later difficulty increases. Public online-judge and coding-site problems yield 30K competitive-programming items; MiniMax-Text-01 generates tests when they are missing, and pass rates select moderately challenging tasks.

Software-engineering RL uses several thousand issue/PR-derived tasks from public GitHub repositories. Each reported item includes a problem description, initial faulty code, and associated tests. A containerized sandbox executes changes: passing all relevant tests earns positive feedback, while compilation errors, runtime failures, or regressions produce zero or negative feedback. Repository revisions, containers, dependencies, generated tests, flaky-test policy, execution transcripts, and final task IDs are not released.

The 25K general RL pool separates objective STEM/factual tasks from tasks without one ground-truth answer. Objective responses receive a five-grade Generative Reward Model comparison against ground truth, calibrated with a human-annotated benchmark and Best-of-N versus pass@N analysis. Open-ended prompts come from an internally tagged pool; unidentified internal and external models generate reference candidates, internal review selects them, and pairwise comparison returns -1, 0, or 1. Constraint-following combines rule and model feedback, while multiple-blind and position-swapped agreement plus a Swiss Round procedure choose references. The underlying records, prompts, model checkpoints, and decision logs are unavailable.

CISPO uses GRPO-style group-relative advantage but clips importance weights, retains token contributions, applies token-level normalization, dynamic sampling, and a length penalty, and omits a KL term. The report mentions 16 off-policy updates per generation batch, numerical precision fixes, AdamW sensitivity, and early truncation after 3,000 consecutive tokens each exceed probability 0.99. Full rollout group size, training decoding settings, and an executable configuration are unknown.

The long-output curriculum proceeds through 40K, 48K, 56K, 64K, 72K, and 80K limits. Stage transitions use generated-sequence perplexity convergence and whether the 99th output-length percentile approaches the current limit. The 80K phase removes prompts the 40K model solves easily, favors harder math/code, and downsamples synthetic reasoning after repetitive, homogeneous outputs destabilize training. These rules are described, but thresholds, stage mixtures, survival counts, and event logs are not.

Evaluation is a separate data surface. MiniMax uses temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95; AIME and GPQA average 32 samples, and LiveCodeBench and FullStackBench average 16. SWE-bench Verified uses a modified Agentless scaffold on 486 compatible tasks rather than all 500. TAU-bench uses a GPT-4.1 user simulator, no custom tools, and at most 40 interactions; MultiChallenge uses GPT-4o judgment. None of these evaluation settings discloses the training rows or validates their quality.

继续预训练与 SFT 必须和 RL 分开阅读。7.5T token 阶段改进 Web/PDF 解析，从网页、论坛和教材抽取自然问答，进行语义去重，并明确不使用合成数据。Long-CoT SFT 覆盖六类宽领域，但只被描述为人工策展的高质量样本；SFT 数量、来源清单、教师列表、候选预算、筛选账本以及记录到模型阶段的映射均未披露。

可验证 RL 池包含四部分。数学从数十万道公开来源与正式竞赛题出发，删除格式错误及不合适题型，对 RL 来源去重，与 SFT 严格隔离，过滤和常用数学测试的相似项，抽取参考答案，并只保留某个强模型 pass@10 严格位于 0 与 0.9 之间的题目，最终接近 50K。SynLogic 在 41 个任务类型上生成约 53K 个实例，以模型可解性设定难度边界，并在后期提高难度。公开在线判题平台与编程网站提供 30K 道竞赛编程题；缺少测试时由 MiniMax-Text-01 生成，再按通过率保留中等难度任务。

软件工程 RL 使用来自公共 GitHub 仓库的数千个 issue/PR 任务。报告中的每条样本包含问题描述、初始缺陷代码和关联测试。容器化沙盒会执行修改：全部相关测试通过时给正反馈，编译错误、运行失败或回归则得到零或负反馈。仓库版本、容器、依赖、生成测试、flaky test 处理、执行记录和最终任务 ID 均未发布。

25K 通用 RL 池区分客观 STEM/事实任务与没有唯一标准答案的任务。客观回答由 Generative Reward Model 依据五档尺度和 ground truth 比较，并通过人工标注基准以及 Best-of-N 与 pass@N 对照来校准。开放式提示来自内部标签池；未具名的内外部模型生成参考候选，经内部质量审查后，以 -1、0、1 做成对比较。约束遵循任务结合规则与模型反馈，多人盲评一致、位置交换一致和 Swiss Round 流程用于选择参考答案。底层记录、评审指令、模型检查点和决策日志都不可获得。

CISPO 使用类似 GRPO 的组相对优势，但裁剪重要性权重并保留 token 梯度贡献，同时采用 token 级归一化、动态采样和长度惩罚，不使用 KL 项。报告提到每个生成批次进行 16 次离策略更新、数值精度修复、AdamW 敏感性，以及当连续 3,000 个 token 的概率都高于 0.99 时提前截断。完整 rollout 组大小、训练解码设置和可执行配置为 unknown。

长输出课程依次经过 40K、48K、56K、64K、72K 与 80K 上限。阶段转换依据生成序列 perplexity 是否收敛，以及输出长度第 99 百分位是否接近当前上限。80K 阶段删除 40K 模型容易解出的提示，提高困难数学与代码的权重，并在重复、同质的输出扰乱训练后降低合成推理数据占比。论文描述了规则，但未给出阈值、逐阶段混合、留存数量或事件日志。

评测是独立的数据面。MiniMax 使用 temperature 1.0 与 top-p 0.95；AIME、GPQA 各平均 32 次采样，LiveCodeBench、FullStackBench 各平均 16 次。SWE-bench Verified 使用修改后的 Agentless scaffold，只评估兼容的 486 个任务而不是完整 500 个。TAU-bench 使用 GPT-4.1 用户模拟器、不加自定义工具且最多交互 40 步；MultiChallenge 由 GPT-4o 评判。这些设置都不能披露训练记录，也不能验证其质量。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv report is concrete about aggregate stages. It gives the 7.5T continual-pretraining budget and 70 percent priority mixture, the SFT domain mix and 60 percent math/code share, RL domain counts, pass-rate filters, software execution contract, GenRM scoring schemes, CISPO design, long-output curriculum, selected stability fixes, and the three-week 512-H800 RL run. This supports a report-level recipe, not record-level replay.

The release artifacts are real but narrower than the recipe. The official Hugging Face collection contains MiniMax-M1-40k, MiniMax-M1-80k, and corresponding Transformers-formatted weights. The official GitHub repository contains the report, model configuration and implementation, inference entry point, tokenizer assets, and deployment/function-calling guides under Apache-2.0. No official M1 training dataset, policy rollouts, reward traces, GenRM checkpoint, sandbox bundle, or end-to-end training code was confirmed.

Benchmark tables support model-behavior claims under stated settings. For example, the report lists 55.6 and 56.0 on its 486-task SWE-bench Verified setup for the 40K and 80K models, respectively. The subset excludes 14 tasks incompatible with MiniMax infrastructure, so direct comparisons require that caveat. Multi-sample math/code scores, TAU-bench with a user simulator, and model-judged MultiChallenge likewise depend on evaluation protocol.

Ablations and training curves provide evidence about CISPO and longer-output scaling in the studied runs. They do not prove that every training trace is correct, every generated test captures the issue specification, the reward model is calibrated outside its benchmark, the data rights are complete, or contamination is absent. Compute cost and benchmark performance are model/process evidence, not data-quality evidence.

官方 arXiv 报告对聚合级阶段披露较具体：给出 7.5T token 继续预训练预算与 70% 重点混合、SFT 领域构成和数学/代码约 60% 的比例、RL 各领域数量、通过率筛选、软件执行契约、GenRM 评分形式、CISPO 设计、长输出课程、部分稳定性修复，以及 512 张 H800 持续三周的 RL 训练。这些内容支持报告级配方，但不足以逐记录重放。

开放制品真实存在，但覆盖范围比论文配方更窄。官方 Hugging Face collection 包含 MiniMax-M1-40k、MiniMax-M1-80k 及对应的 Transformers 格式权重。官方 GitHub 仓库在 Apache-2.0 下提供报告、模型配置与实现、推理入口、tokenizer 资产以及部署和函数调用指南。尚未确认官方 M1 训练数据、策略 rollout、奖励轨迹、GenRM 检查点、沙盒包或端到端训练代码。

基准表只能支持指定设置下的模型行为。例如，报告在自己的 486 任务 SWE-bench Verified 设置上给 40K 与 80K 模型分别报告 55.6 和 56.0；由于排除了 14 个与 MiniMax 基础设施不兼容的任务，横向比较必须保留这一限定。数学/代码的多次采样分数、使用用户模拟器的 TAU-bench 和模型评判的 MultiChallenge 同样依赖评测协议。

消融与训练曲线为所研究运行中的 CISPO 和长输出扩展提供证据，却不能证明每条训练轨迹都正确、每组生成测试都完整表达 issue 规范、奖励模型能在基准外保持校准、数据权利完整或不存在污染。算力成本与基准表现属于模型和流程证据，不是数据质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The data-recipe contribution is the disclosed combination of feedback regimes at long output lengths. MiniMax-M1 places final-answer rules, task-specific logic verifiers, programming tests, containerized software execution, five-grade Generative Reward Model judgments, pairwise reference comparisons, and constraint checks inside one progressively mixed RL curriculum. Reports often name an optimizer while leaving this feedback composition vague; here the categories and approximate counts are visible.

CISPO changes the optimization interface by clipping importance-sampling weights rather than dropping token updates. This matters for long traces because low-probability reflective tokens can otherwise lose gradient contribution during repeated off-policy updates. Hybrid Lightning Attention simultaneously lowers rollout cost, while staged 40K-to-80K expansion and data reweighting make output budget a curriculum decision rather than only an inference option.

The software-engineering component also broadens the target data object from answer-only questions to environment-backed interventions. Public GitHub issues and pull requests become containerized tasks with faulty code and tests, and runtime outcomes provide feedback. The report thereby exposes a concrete bridge between RLVR and agent training, although the actual environments are not released.

None of the ingredients alone is new: long reasoning SFT, GRPO-style relative advantage, rule rewards, execution tests, reward models, difficulty filtering, and curriculum learning all have precedents. The distinctive contribution is their large-scale disclosed composition with open 40K/80K weights. It should not be described as an open training recipe because data, verifiers, environments, reward artifacts, and training implementation remain incomplete.

从数据配方角度看，贡献在于公开了长输出条件下多种反馈机制的组合。MiniMax-M1 把最终答案规则、任务专属逻辑验证器、编程测试、容器化软件执行、五档 Generative Reward Model 判断、参考答案成对比较和约束检查放进同一套渐进混合 RL 课程。许多报告只给出优化器名称而不说明反馈构成；本报告至少公开了类别和近似数量。

CISPO 通过裁剪重要性采样权重而不是丢弃 token 更新来改变优化接口。这对长轨迹有意义，因为低概率的反思 token 在反复离策略更新时可能失去梯度贡献。混合 Lightning Attention 同时降低 rollout 成本；40K 到 80K 的分阶段扩展与数据重加权，则把输出预算变成课程决策，而不只是推理选项。

软件工程部分还把目标数据对象从答案型问题扩展为环境支持的干预。公共 GitHub issue 和 PR 被转换成含缺陷代码与测试的容器任务，运行结果提供反馈。由此，报告给出了 RLVR 与 agent training 之间的具体连接，但实际环境并未发布。

这些单项都不是首次出现：Long-CoT SFT、类似 GRPO 的相对优势、规则奖励、执行测试、奖励模型、难度筛选和课程学习都有先例。独特之处在于它们的大规模公开组合以及开放的 40K/80K 权重。由于数据、验证器、环境、奖励制品和训练实现仍不完整，不应把它描述为开放训练配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest gap is release scope. MiniMax publishes weights and inference/deployment assets, but no continual-pretraining corpus, Long-CoT SFT set, RL prompt set, sampled policy output, reward ledger, rejected candidate, or stage manifest. Aggregate counts cannot identify which records entered which run or allow another team to reconstruct the mixture.

Provenance and rights remain coarse. Terms such as public sources, official competitions, online judges, coding websites, books, Web/PDF, and public GitHub repositories omit item IDs, immutable revisions, extraction dates, transformations, attribution, and license chain. The Apache-2.0 labels on current official code and weight pages do not license unreleased upstream training material.

Verifier replay is not possible. Math answer extraction can mishandle equivalent forms; final-answer and format rewards do not validate reasoning; pass-rate difficulty depends on unidentified models. MiniMax-Text-01-generated tests may encode incomplete specifications, while containers, dependencies, flaky-test policy, and execution logs are absent. GenRM scoring inherits reference quality and judge bias; the paper reports length preference and online recalibration but not the reward artifacts or calibration results.

Training reproduction is also blocked. The exact CISPO implementation, full optimizer configuration, training decoding parameters, rollout group size, dynamic data weights, stage-transition thresholds, per-component rewards, early-truncation events, optimizer states, and checkpoints are unavailable. The reported three-week run and rental estimate are useful resource disclosures, not substitutes for an executable run manifest.

Decontamination is partial. Math RL describes n-gram and embedding checks against common tests, but benchmark identities and revisions, thresholds, matches, and removals are not published. Comparable evidence is absent for most continual-pretraining, SFT, general RL, software-engineering, tool-use, and long-context surfaces.

Evaluation has protocol dependencies. SWE-bench uses 486 compatible tasks and a modified Agentless scaffold; several benchmarks use many sampled responses; TAU-bench uses a model-based user and a 40-step cap; MultiChallenge uses model judgment. Scores under these settings do not establish trace correctness, rights, source diversity, verifier validity, safety coverage, or absence of contamination.

最大缺口是发布范围。MiniMax 公开了权重与推理/部署资产，却没有发布继续预训练语料、Long-CoT SFT 集、RL 提示集、采样策略输出、奖励账本、被拒候选或阶段清单。聚合数量无法指出哪些记录进入哪个训练运行，也不能让其他团队重建混合。

来源与权利披露仍然粗粒度。“公开来源”“正式竞赛”“在线判题平台”“编程网站”“书籍”“Web/PDF”和“公共 GitHub 仓库”等标签缺少样本 ID、不可变版本、抽取日期、变换过程、署名与许可链。当前官方代码和权重页面的 Apache-2.0 标签不能为未发布的上游训练材料授予许可。

验证器无法重放。数学答案抽取可能误判等价形式，最终答案与格式奖励不验证推理过程，通过率难度又依赖未具名模型。MiniMax-Text-01 生成的测试可能只覆盖不完整规范，而容器、依赖、flaky test 政策和执行日志均不可获得。GenRM 评分继承参考答案质量与裁判偏差；论文报告了长度偏好和在线重校准，却没有发布奖励制品或校准结果。

训练复现同样受阻。精确 CISPO 实现、完整优化器配置、训练解码参数、rollout 组大小、动态数据权重、阶段转换阈值、各奖励分量、提前截断事件、优化器状态和检查点都未提供。持续三周的训练与租用成本估算是有用的资源披露，但不能替代可执行运行清单。

去污染只覆盖部分范围。数学 RL 描述了针对常用测试集的 n-gram 与 embedding 检查，但没有公布基准身份与版本、阈值、匹配项和删除项；大部分继续预训练、SFT、通用 RL、软件工程、工具使用和长上下文数据面缺少同等证据。

评测依赖具体协议。SWE-bench 只用 486 个兼容任务和修改后的 Agentless scaffold；多个基准会采样多条回答；TAU-bench 使用模型化用户并限制 40 步；MultiChallenge 由模型裁判评估。这些分数不能建立轨迹正确性、权利完整性、来源多样性、验证器有效性、安全覆盖或无污染结论。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, MiniMax-M1 is useful because it naturally separates into five inspectable ledgers: continual-pretraining disclosure, SFT disclosure, RL/data-and-reward disclosure, released artifacts, and evaluation. The first ledger has token scale and broad mixture; the second has domains and one proportion; the third has the most detailed counts and feedback contracts; the fourth has weights and inference code but no training data; the fifth has protocol-specific model results.

Recipe designers can reuse the conceptual structure: isolate SFT from RL, attach domain-appropriate verifiers, preserve executable software tasks as versioned environments, start with deterministic feedback, monitor model-reward bias online, and treat longer output limits as a staged data curriculum. They should add what the report lacks: immutable source IDs, licenses, candidate and rejection logs, per-component rewards, environment hashes, exact stage mixtures, and run membership.

Auditors should pin the GitHub and Hugging Face revisions, verify both weight variants, classify repository files as inference or training assets, and avoid treating the collection as a dataset release. A disclosure table should record each stage's sources, counts, generators, filters, verifiers, environment, rollout budget, released artifacts, rights, decontamination, and evaluation overlap separately.

The official weights make behavioral reproduction possible under sufficient hardware, while the paper makes aggregate recipe comparison possible. Neither enables data-level reproduction or RL replay. Appropriate reuse therefore requires independent sourcing, licensing, contamination checks, verifier validation, and software-environment reconstruction rather than copying the reported counts as if they specified an open corpus.

对于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，MiniMax-M1 的价值在于可以自然拆成五本可检查账：继续预训练披露、SFT 披露、RL 数据与奖励披露、开放制品，以及评测。第一本只有 token 规模与宽泛混合；第二本只有领域和一个比例；第三本给出最详细的数量与反馈契约；第四本包含权重和推理代码但没有训练数据；第五本是依赖特定协议的模型结果。

配方设计者可以复用其概念结构：严格分开 SFT 与 RL，为各领域配置合适验证器，把可执行软件任务保存成有版本的环境，先使用确定性反馈，在线监测模型奖励偏差，并把更长输出上限视为分阶段数据课程。同时应补齐报告缺少的内容：不可变来源 ID、许可、候选与拒绝日志、各奖励分量、环境哈希、精确阶段混合以及运行归属。

审计者应固定 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 版本，核验两套权重，把仓库文件区分为推理资产或训练资产，并避免把 model collection 当成数据集发布。标准披露表应分别记录每个阶段的来源、数量、生成器、筛选、验证器、环境、rollout 预算、开放制品、权利、去污染与评测重叠。

官方权重使具备足够硬件的用户可以复现模型行为，论文则使聚合级配方能够比较；二者都不能实现数据级复现或 RL 重放。因此，合理复用仍需独立获取数据、核验许可、检查污染、验证奖励器并重建软件环境，不能把报告数量直接当作开放语料规格。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep five ledgers separate: continual pretraining, Long-CoT SFT, mixed-feedback RL, released weights/code, and evaluation. Evidence in one does not complete another.
  • SFT disclosure is thin: six domains and about 60 percent math/code are reported, but count, sources, teachers, filters, and rows are unknown.
  • RL disclosure is richer: nearly 50K math, approximately 53K logic, 30K coding, several thousand software-engineering, and 25K general prompts, each with different feedback contracts.
  • The official release verifies 40K/80K weights and inference/deployment code; no M1 training dataset, reward trace, sandbox bundle, or end-to-end training implementation was confirmed.
  • The 40K-to-80K schedule includes data reselection and downsampling, so the difference is not only an inference budget change.
  • Benchmark scores depend on sampling, judges, subsets, and scaffolds; they are not evidence of record-level quality, rights, lineage, or decontamination.

• 分开维护五本账：继续预训练、Long-CoT SFT、混合反馈 RL、已发布权重/代码与评测；一本账中的证据不能补全另一本。
  • SFT 披露较薄：只报告六个领域及数学/代码约 60%，数量、来源、教师、筛选与记录均为 unknown。
  • RL 披露更丰富：接近 50K 数学、约 53K 逻辑、30K 编程、数千软件工程与 25K 通用提示，且各自使用不同反馈契约。
  • 官方发布确认了 40K/80K 权重以及推理/部署代码；尚未确认 M1 训练数据、奖励轨迹、沙盒包或端到端训练实现。
  • 40K 到 80K 的课程同时重新选择和降采样数据，因此两者差异不只是推理预算变化。
  • 基准分数依赖采样、裁判、子集和 scaffold，不能作为记录级质量、权利、血缘或去污染证据。
